Courage aur perseverance ka magical talisman—jis ke aage mushkile gayab.
Shuru karne ki himmat, chalane ki himmat.
Khamoshi se duniya jeeto.
Khamoshi buddhimani hai.
Grit junoon hai.
Khamoshi wisdom ka refuge hai.
Grit disciplined passion hai.
Khamoshi patli hai.
Himmat action ka darwaza hai.
Mind empty, formless, shapeless—jaise paani.
Grit chhote roz marra kaam se naapta.
Grit vijeta banati hai.
Grit discipline hai jo persistence pehenti.
Darpok baar baar marte hain.
Khamosh raho aur mehnat karo.
Koi bhi hamesha wise nahi.
Josh ki lagan hi grit hoti hai.
Khamoshi mulayam hai.
Chuppi sach ke liye jagah banati hai.
Toofan ka saamna karo.
Saahas woh hai jab darr se marna ho, phir bhi savari karna.
Grit lachila-pan hai.
Courage i resistance to fear, mastery of fear—na absence of fear.
Apne darr ko jeeto.
Grit abhedya hai.
